title: Main Aun o Muhammad Ko Tere Pass
body:
Main Aun o Muhammad ko Tere paas hun layi
<<DIVIDER>>
Aur daman e dukhiya main, nahi Kuch mere Bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Qurban main karti mere, bhaiya main tumhi par,
hathoon mein agar hoti, mere sari khudayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Qurbani ko doh laal hain, bhaiya mere hazir, ye arz main karne ko, tere paas hun layi
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Bhaiyya Yahan Khoon sey, charaghon ko Jalao
Zulmat sey agar larni hey Sehra mein larai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Haider ka lahu hai ye bhuja sakta hai pal mai
Dushman nay jo islam ko hai aag lagai
